name: esp-idf-tools
title_zh: 编译烧录一条命令，ESP32 开发板不用再开第二个终
tagline_zh: 在编辑器里直接 build、flash、切 target，省去来回敲 idf.py 的功夫。
tagline_en: Compile, flash, set target, and list serial ports right inside your chat. Skip the idf.py dance and keep your.
desc_en: Control ESP-IDF projects using the ESP-IDF Tools local MCP server (idf.py mcp-server via EIM). Use to build projects, flash firmware, set targets, and inspect project status and connected serial devices.
why_zh: 把 ESP-IDF 的本地 MCP 服务器接进对话流，让 AI 替你执行编译烧录，而不是只给建议。
why_en: Wires the local ESP-IDF MCP server into your conversation, so the AI executes builds and flashes instead of just suggesting.
limit_zh: 只认 ESP-IDF 项目且本机需已配置 idf.py 环境；不管理依赖、不处理分区表，烧录失败不会自动回滚。
limit_en: Requires a configured ESP-IDF environment and local idf.py. No dependency management or partition table edits; failed flashes won't auto-rollback.
title_en: Build and flash ESP32 from your editor, no terminal hopping
